method: candidate lines proposed by corridor detection; identity decided from printed address runs
why_not_one_block_off: PRINTED NAME. The chosen corridor is lettered vertically 'AVE. E. OR POST OFFICE' inside its own roadway on BOTH sheets. WIDTH AND REPEATED READS. Sheet 75 block-face lines, read on all three block rows: 36TH-37TH 2033.1/2245.3, 37TH-38TH 2033.4/2247.6, 38TH-39TH 2034.7/2247.7 -> centres 2139.2, 2140.5, 2141.2, mean 2140.3, faces 212-214 px apart. Sheet 83: 39TH-40TH 1068.5/1275.6, 40TH-41ST 1063.3/1271.2, 41ST-42ND 1058.8/1268.3 -> centres 1172.1, 1167.3, 1163.6, mean 1167.7, faces 207-210 px apart. 70 ft = ~212 px on these plates, so both are full avenues, not the ~20 ft (~60 px) mid-block alleys. ADDRESS RUNS ACROSS THE LINE. Sheet 75, along 37TH ST: west of the line '421 423' (400 block), east of it '501 503 505' (500 block). Sheet 83, along 39TH/40TH ST: west '421 423' and '422 424' (400 block), east '501 503 505' and '502 504 506 508' (500 block). The identical 400/500 change occurs across this corridor on both sheets. CITY BLOCK NUMBERS AGREE. The column immediately west/north of the line is 516-518 on sheet 75 and 519-521 on sheet 83; the column immediately east/south is 456-458 on sheet 75 and 459-461 on sheet 83. Avenue E is the boundary between the 5xx and 4xx block columns on both plates. THE AVENUE'S OWN FRONTAGE NUMBERS. Sheet 75 reads 3702-3728 even / 3701-3727 odd (the 37TH-38TH block of Ave E); sheet 83 reads 4002-4028 even / 4001-4027 odd (the 40TH-41ST block). Sheet 75 covers 36TH-39TH and sheet 83 covers 39TH-42ND, so 37xx and 40xx are two blocks of one continuous Avenue E address sequence running west. ONE BLOCK NORTH is excluded: that corridor is lettered 'AVE. D. OR MARKET' (sheet 75 faces 1028.2/1236.5, centre 1132.4) and carries the 300/400 change, and it separates block column 576-578 from 516-518 - not the 400/500 change we read. ONE BLOCK SOUTH is excluded: that corridor is lettered 'AVE. F. OR CHURCH' (sheet 83 faces 2067.1/2279.7, centre 2173.4; sheet 75 faces 3039.5/3257.2, centre 3148.4) and carries the 500/600 change - on sheet 83 '521 523' lies west of it and '601 603 605' east of it - and it separates block column 459-461 from 399-401. THE NEAR-EQUAL-NATIVE-X TRAP IS EXPLICITLY REJECTED HERE. Sheet 75's Ave E centre (2140.3) is only 33 px from sheet 83's Ave F centre (2173.4), so matching on native x alone would have tied Ave E to Ave F and sheared the row by a full block. The two plates do NOT frame the same avenue band: sheet 75's key map covers C-F and sheet 83's covers D-G, and the key-map rectangles confirm the one-block shift (sheet 75 x 1550-1925, sheet 83 x 1675-2045, i.e. +125 = exactly one avenue column). The true offset is therefore about -974 px, not ~0. CANDIDATES REJECTED. None of the six proposed candidates is a street: sheet 75's 1743/2760/726 and sheet 83's 744/1761/2778 all fall in block interiors or on Galveston Houston & Henderson / Gulf Colorado & Santa Fe track pairs (rails drawn ~13 px apart) rather than on a 212 px roadway. The values reported here are ruler-read avenue centres, not candidates. CROSS-CHECK. Two independently measured corridors give the same sheet75->sheet83 x offset: Ave E centre -972.6 and Ave F centre -975.0 (spread 2.4 px), against ~1006 px for a one-block error.
